WITH store_counts AS (
  SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
  FROM customer
  GROUP BY store_id
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(customer_count) AS total
  FROM store_counts
),
store_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.store_id,
    sc.customer_count,
    CAST(sc.customer_count AS FLOAT) / tc.total AS store_share
  FROM store_counts sc,
       total_count tc
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(store_share) AS average_share
  FROM store_shares
)
SELECT 
  ss.store_id,
  ss.customer_count,
  ss.store_share,
  ss.store_share - avs.average_share AS share_diff
FROM store_shares ss,
     avg_share avs
WHERE ss.store_share > avs.average_share
ORDER BY share_diff DESC
LIMIT 10
